meta.name: google-ads-audit
meta.description: Google Ads account audit and business context setup. Run this first — it gathers business information, analyzes account health, and saves context that all other ads skills reuse. Trigger on "audit my ads", "ads audit", "set up my ads", "onboard", "account overview", "how's my account", "ads health check", "what should I fix in my ads", or when the user is new to NotFair and hasn't run an audit before. Also trigger proactively when other ads skills detect that business-context.json is missing.

copy.tagline: 审计谷歌广告账户并设置业务上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你管理谷歌广告账户并需要快速了解账户健康状况。
copy.tagline_en: Audit your Google Ads account and set up business context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and need a quick health overview.

howto.what: Claude 会先检查你的 Google Ads 账户健康度，收集业务信息（如行业、网站、竞争对手），并保存一份业务档案。之后所有广告相关技能都会复用这份档案。它只诊断不修改，修复建议会引导你使用其他技能执行。
howto.when: 当你提到“审计我的广告”、“广告审计”、“设置我的广告”、“账户概览”、“广告健康检查”等关键词，或者你是新用户且未运行过审计时触发。其他广告技能检测到缺少业务档案时也会主动触发。

say.text: 审计我的 Google Ads 账户
say.note: 触发完整审计，生成脉冲指标和诊断报告。

say.text: 帮我检查广告账户的健康状况
say.note: 同样触发审计，重点关注账户整体健康。

say.text: 只看某个广告系列的审计
say.note: 触发范围审计，仅分析指定系列。

howto.what_en: Claude audits your Google Ads account health, gathers business info (industry, website, competitors), and saves a business context file reused by all other ads skills. It diagnoses only, never mutates; fix suggestions route to other skills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "audit my ads", "ads audit", "set up my ads", "onboard", "account overview", "how's my account", "ads health check", or similar. Also triggers proactively when other ads skills detect missing business context.

say_en.note: Triggers full audit, generates pulse metrics and diagnosis.
Also triggers audit, focusing on overall health.
Triggers scoped audit for that campaign only.
